up: Return exact activity values and structures for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614275. Include the molecule ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, activity type, standard value, and standard units. Filter to only include rows where standard_relation is '='.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  act.standard_type,
  act.standard_value,
  act.standard_units
FROM assays a
JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE a.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614275'
  AND act.standard_relation = '=';
